scorecard.scale: A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1, F=0; +/-0.3. Mean >=3 approve; >=2.3 approve with concerns; otherwise needs improvement.
scorecard.interpretation: Subjective reviewer grades, computed aggregate; not predictive-performance measurements.

aggregate_computation.command:
python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('docs/audits/2026-09-27-release-design-rereview.json'))
grades = d['scorecard']['grades']
pts = [g['new_points'] for g in grades]
avg = sum(pts) / len(pts)
avg_r = round(avg, 2)
verdict = 'approve' if avg_r >= 3.0 else ('approve with concerns' if avg_r >= 2.3 else 'needs improvement')
print(f'n={len(pts)} sum={sum(pts)} avg={avg} avg_rounded={avg_r} verdict={verdict}')
"
